description: Replace the tools bound to an Agent. Read the current Agent first; this replaces its bindings. Use saved tool IDs; configure connection settings privately in the PyAI console. Never supply credentials.

body.description: Replace bindings using saved tool IDs. Existing settings are preserved for retained bindings. Credentials and connection settings are not accepted through MCP.

tool_id.description: ID of an existing tool. Configure its connection privately in the PyAI console.
